summary: Comprehensive first-iteration testing of AgentForge Quest (mobile-first PWA, anonymous device profile). Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass after a 1-line fixture-name correction in the test. Frontend: All key flows verified on mobile viewport 414x896 — Home HUD with Lv 1 + XP + streak, Continue CTA navigates to Mission Briefing, Campaign Map with 10 worlds (first world auto-expanded, 12 level rows, only first level unlocked), Agent Lab (3 scenarios, prompt input, tool toggles), Arena (9 challenges, fix-bad-prompt solved via options 0,2,3 -> Solved + challenge-done), Brain Dump (add + tags + filter), You page (focus/motion/sound toggles all present), Skills/Badges/Review pages render correctly. PWA assets manifest.json + service-worker.js served with 200.

minor.issue: Schema field naming inconsistency: payload uses snake_case 'daily_mission_enabled' / 'preferred_time' (not 'daily_reminder_enabled'/'reminder_time' suggested by the review_request). Test was updated to match implementation. Documenting for awareness — recommend updating problem-statement docs to reflect actual field names.

issues: React Router future-flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) on every navigation — cosmetic but spams console; opt-in to future flags to silence.

action_items: (Optional) Document correct notification-prefs field names (daily_mission_enabled, streak_reminder_enabled, review_reminder_enabled, boss_reminder_enabled, braindump_reminder_enabled, weekly_recap_enabled, preferred_time) in PRD/problem statement so future agents/UI consumers use the right keys.
(Optional) Add React Router v7 future flags to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 629 lines — borderline; consider splitting routes into routers (lab, challenges, content, profile) for maintainability before phase 2.
Backend correctly excludes MongoDB _id from responses (uses projection in queries) — good.
All API endpoints prefixed with /api — good for Kubernetes ingress routing.
data-testid coverage is excellent across pages (world-{id}, level-row-{id}, challenge-{id}, option-{i}, scenario-{id}, agent-prompt, toggle-focus/motion/sound, braindump-input, braindump-add).
Mission progression is correctly idempotent: re-completing a finished mission returns already_completed=true and xp_gained=0 (verified).
Level-complete bonus and badge awarding (first-spark, level-cleared) verified end-to-end with persistence across GET.
Lab live=True with no DEEPSEEK_API_KEY gracefully degrades to mock with live.mode='unavailable' — verified.
test_credentials: No auth required. Tests use random TEST_<uuid> X-Device-Id header per session.
seed_data_creation: Tests create per-run device profiles, complete missions for level 11-01-prompt-engineering to seed review cards and badges, and create + delete one braindump + one lab build. All TEST_-prefixed data is isolated by device id.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_agentforge.py is the canonical regression suite (24 tests, ~6s). Use the content-rich level '11-01-prompt-engineering' for end-to-end progression tests (it has briefing+concept+quiz+myth+build+boss). The first globally-unlocked level for fresh device is '00-01-dev-environment' inside world id=0 (numeric). Notification prefs payload schema: daily_mission_enabled/streak_reminder_enabled/review_reminder_enabled/boss_reminder_enabled/braindump_reminder_enabled/weekly_recap_enabled/preferred_time/push_enabled_future_flag — NOT the names hinted in problem statement. PWA endpoints /manifest.json and /service-worker.js confirmed 200. No console errors on any page, only React Router v7 future-flag warnings (cosmetic).
rca of the issue: No production bugs found. Single test failure in initial run was a test-side issue (wrong field names in test payload for notifications/preferences) — corrected and now passing. Map.jsx 'world-0 not expanding on click' anomaly observed during exploration was also a test artifact: world-0 is auto-expanded by default for fresh users, so the test's first click was actually a COLLAPSE; verified default-expanded state shows all 12 levels correctly with proper lock indicators.
